name: OpenAI Compatible
description: For OpenAI or any provider that exposes an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and uses auth.json plus config.toml.

modelOptions.name: OpenAI CLI Tool
modelOptions.description: Install the official OpenAI terminal coding agent.
modelOptions.configTemplate:
# OpenAI-compatible runtime configuration
model_provider = "openai-compatible"
model = "gpt-5.4"
model_reasoning_effort = "high"
disable_response_storage = true

[model_providers.openai-compatible]
name = "openai-compatible"
base_url = "https://api.openai.com/v1"
wire_api = "responses"

[paths]
workspace = "~/projects"
